flavor: Flame answers flame with a deeper fever.
Two waters forget where one ended.
Earth joins earth and becomes a country.
Air urges air into motion.
The tide lifts its veil.
Even stone yields to a tireless wind.
The air carries one bright thought.
Hard earth softens without surrendering.
Heat reveals the strength sleeping in stone.
A spark finds a voice large enough for the sky.
Wandering dust settles into promise.
Warm rain gathers the dust home.
Fire writes permanence into clay.
The earth answers water in color.
A wall becomes a promise against the dark.
The wind leaves a direction behind.
Water rises when heat leaves no room to rest.
The open sea gives the air a thunderous voice.
Water wakes the dark promise within the land.
Wind lifts a bright fragment from the fire.
